Subject: Removable Hard Drives

We have an IT Certification lab with removable hard drives.  We have about 50 workstations with the removable hard drive shells on them.  We also have about 200 hard drives in the matching cases.  All of these are PATA drives.

We just upgraded the lab and now the new computers only have SATA controllers.

Have any of you came across a similar situation?  Is there a cheaper alternatives than just buying 200 new SATA drives along with the shells and cases?  Is there a SATA to PATA converter?  I've seen one going the other way, not sure about this one.

Thanks,
Jeff.
